concerns.text: FR-001 mandates downloading 'NOAA/PRISM climate data'. The tasks (T005c1, T005c3) implement Daymet data and document the deviation, but there is no task to actually download or process NOAA/PRISM data as required by the spec. The spec requirement is effectively unimplemented.

SC-002 requires measuring the proportion of 'insufficient data' cells against a target of '[deferred]%'. Task T043 reports raw values and notes 'Target undefined', but there is no task to define, calculate, or validate the specific target threshold required to satisfy the 'Measurable Outcomes' definition of the success criterion.

SC-003 requires measuring GAMM convergence against a target of '[deferred]%'. Task T043 reports raw rates but lacks a task to define or validate the specific target threshold, leaving the success criterion untestable as written.

SC-004 requires measuring CI width against a target of '[deferred] days'. Task T043 and T033a1 report raw widths but lack a task to define or validate the specific target threshold, rendering the success criterion untestable.

US-3 Acceptance Scenario 1 expects the output of 'Riemannian trajectory analysis' to include a 'p-value'. Task T031c (Riemannian analysis) outputs only a shift vector; the p-value is generated in a separate task T032b (Permutation test). There is no single task that covers the full 'analysis execution' described in the acceptance scenario, creating a gap in the implementation of the specific acceptance criteria.

Task T050b is tagged to verify 'Plan & Spec Alignment' and fail on contradictions. However, the spec and plan contain a known, documented contradiction (NOAA/PRISM vs Daymet) which T005c3 explicitly handles. T050b lacks a mechanism to exclude documented deviations, meaning it will fail the pipeline on a known, accepted condition. This is a stale logic pattern from a previous spec version.
